{{Otheruses|Hawk}}
The '''Hawk series''' was a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] line produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the Clone Wars the series was discontinued to make way for the production of military vessels. The line was continued some time before [[Darth Krayt]] became [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].
